name: Ghost Mold
disable: DC 29 Survival check (expert) to remove the mold safely
reset: Unless entirely eradicated (typically with acid or fire), the mold regrows over the course of 2 weeks.

items.name: Moldy Death
items.text: If a creature dies while taking persistent damage from the ghost mold spores, a new patch of mold blossoms from their corpse. The GM might decide that the creature's spirit rises as a ghost or other undead.

items.name: Spore Burst
items.text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A living creature moves adjacent to the mold or the mold is included in the area of a vitality effect

---
Effect The mold releases a burst of spores in a 10-foot emanation. Any creature in the area must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 4d12 void damage and is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature takes 8d12 void,2d12 persistent,void damage and is Frightened 3.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is Confused for as long as it remains frightened.

text: A patch of black mold releases spoors when living creatures approach.
